title: Other Discoveries, 1937-8 (Remains of buildings): Jerusalem, moat area near the Damascus Gate
author: (round-up, Department of Antiquities)
location_note: West face of the western tower flanking the Damascus Gate, Jerusalem; placed by name.
notes: Shaft against the Damascus Gate west tower (reported in full as QDAP10-001): drafted masonry on a moulded plinth; curtain wall of several periods. No eligible feature.
